# Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ThreadGate 3-way eval

set -e

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/turn_residual_gating

PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python3.12
EVAL_SCRIPT=src/eval_phase2_gar.py
LLAMA=/root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B-Instruct/
CONV_PATH=data/ultrachat_eval_sample.json
OUT_ROOT=runs/eval_llama_tg_s42

# ── Auto-detect latest TG checkpoint ────────────────────────
TG_RUN_DIR=runs/phase2_llama_tg_s42
TG_CKPT=""
for ep in epoch_2 epoch_1 epoch_0; do
    candidate="$TG_RUN_DIR/$ep"
    if [ -f "$candidate/gate_params.pt" ] && [ -d "$candidate/lora" ]; then
        TG_CKPT="$candidate"
        break
    fi
done

# Fallback: check run dir root (final checkpoint may be at top level)
if [ -z "$TG_CKPT" ]; then
    if [ -f "$TG_RUN_DIR/gate_params.pt" ] && [ -d "$TG_RUN_DIR/lora" ]; then
        TG_CKPT="$TG_RUN_DIR"
    fi
fi

if [ -z "$TG_CKPT" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: No Llama TG checkpoint found in $TG_RUN_DIR"
    echo "Training may still be in progress. Available:"
    ls -la "$TG_RUN_DIR"/ 2>/dev/null || echo "  (directory not found)"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Using TG checkpoint: $TG_CKPT"
echo "Base model: $LLAMA"
echo "Output: $OUT_ROOT"
echo ""

mkdir -p "$OUT_ROOT"

# Part 1: Teacher-Forced GAR (fixed conversations)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

echo "========== [1/8] Base + GAR-ours (teacher-forced) =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --model "$LLAMA" \
  --gate-type none \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_base_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

# ── 2/4: Base + GAR-Dongre (TF) ─────────────────────────────
echo "========== [2/8] Base + GAR-Dongre (teacher-forced) =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --model "$LLAMA" \
  --gate-type none \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_base_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

# ── 3/4: TG + GAR-ours (TF) ─────────────────────────────────
echo "========== [3/8] TG + GAR-ours (teacher-forced) =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --model "$LLAMA" \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --checkpoint-dir "$TG_CKPT" \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_tg_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

# ── 4/4: TG + GAR-Dongre (TF) ───────────────────────────────
echo "========== [4/8] TG + GAR-Dongre (teacher-forced) =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --model "$LLAMA" \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --checkpoint-dir "$TG_CKPT" \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_tg_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ar_base_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ar_base_dongre" \

  --checkpoint-dir "$TG_CKPT" \

        turn_embedding.to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)

#!/bin/bash
# Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ThreadGate 3-way eval
# Base vs LoRA-only vs TG
# GAR-ours (TF + AR) | GAR-Dongre (TF + AR) | PPL
set -e

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/turn_residual_gating

PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python3.12
EVAL_SCRIPT=src/eval_phase2_gar.py
LLAMA=/root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B-Instruct/
CONV_PATH=data/ultrachat_eval_sample.json
OUT_ROOT=runs/eval_llama_tg_s42

# ── Auto-detect latest TG checkpoint ────────────────────────
TG_RUN_DIR=runs/phase2_llama_tg_s42
TG_CKPT=""
for ep_dir in $(ls -1d ${TG_RUN_DIR}/epoch_* 2>/dev/null | sort -t_ -k2 -rn); do
    if [ -f "$ep_dir/gate_params.pt" ] && [ -d "$ep_dir/lora" ]; then
        TG_CKPT="$ep_dir"
        break
    fi
done
if [ -z "$TG_CKPT" ] && [ -f "$TG_RUN_DIR/gate_params.pt" ] && [ -d "$TG_RUN_DIR/lora" ]; then
    TG_CKPT="$TG_RUN_DIR"
fi
if [ -z "$TG_CKPT" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: No Llama TG checkpoint found in $TG_RUN_DIR"
    echo "Training may still be in progress. Available:"
    ls -la "$TG_RUN_DIR"/ 2>/dev/null || echo "  (directory not found)"
    exit 1
fi
echo "Using TG checkpoint: $TG_CKPT"

# ── Auto-detect LoRA-only checkpoint ────────────────────────
LO_RUN_DIR=runs/phase2_llama_lo_s42
LO_CKPT=""
for ep_dir in $(ls -1d ${LO_RUN_DIR}/epoch_* 2>/dev/null | sort -t_ -k2 -rn); do
    if [ -d "$ep_dir/lora" ]; then
        LO_CKPT="$ep_dir"
        break
    fi
done
if [ -z "$LO_CKPT" ] && [ -d "$LO_RUN_DIR/lora" ]; then
    LO_CKPT="$LO_RUN_DIR"
fi
if [ -z "$LO_CKPT" ]; then
    echo "WARNING: LoRA-only checkpoint not found in $LO_RUN_DIR, skipping LoRA-only eval"
else
    echo "Using LoRA-only checkpoint: $LO_CKPT"
fi

echo "Base model: $LLAMA"
echo "Output: $OUT_ROOT"
echo ""

mkdir -p "$OUT_ROOT"

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --model "$LLAMA" \
  --gate-type none \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_base_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

echo "========== [TF] Base + GAR-Dongre =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --model "$LLAMA" \
  --gate-type none \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_base_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

if [ -n "$LO_CKPT" ]; then
    echo "========== [TF] LoRA-only + GAR-ours =========="
    $PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
      --model "$LLAMA" \
      --gate-type none \
      --checkpoint-dir "$LO_CKPT" \
      --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
      --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_lo_ours" \
      --gar-variant ours \
      --gate-profile

    echo "========== [TF] LoRA-only + GAR-Dongre =========="
    $PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
      --model "$LLAMA" \
      --gate-type none \
      --checkpoint-dir "$LO_CKPT" \
      --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
      --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_lo_dongre" \
      --gar-variant dongre \
      --gate-profile
fi

echo "========== [TF] TG + GAR-ours =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --model "$LLAMA" \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --checkpoint-dir "$TG_CKPT" \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_tg_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --model "$LLAMA" \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --checkpoint-dir "$TG_CKPT" \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_tg_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

echo "========== [AR] Base + GAR-ours =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --model "$LLAMA" \
  --gate-type none \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ar_base_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

echo "========== [AR] Base + GAR-Dongre =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --model "$LLAMA" \
  --gate-type none \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ar_base_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

if [ -n "$LO_CKPT" ]; then
    echo "========== [AR] LoRA-only + GAR-ours =========="
    $PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
      --model "$LLAMA" \
      --gate-type none \
      --checkpoint-dir "$LO_CKPT" \
      --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ar_lo_ours" \
      --gar-variant ours \
      --gate-profile

    echo "========== [AR] LoRA-only + GAR-Dongre =========="
    $PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
      --model "$LLAMA" \
      --gate-type none \
      --checkpoint-dir "$LO_CKPT" \
      --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ar_lo_dongre" \
      --gar-variant dongre \
      --gate-profile
fi

echo "========== [AR] TG + GAR-ours =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --model "$LLAMA" \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --checkpoint-dir "$TG_CKPT" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ar_tg_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

echo "========== [AR] TG + GAR-Dongre =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --model "$LLAMA" \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --checkpoint-dir "$TG_CKPT" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ar_tg_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Summary
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
echo ""
echo "================================================================"
echo "Llama eval complete"
echo "================================================================"
echo "TG checkpoint: $TG_CKPT"
if [ -n "$LO_CKPT" ]; then
    echo "LoRA-only checkpoint: $LO_CKPT"
else
    echo "LoRA-only: SKIPPED (not found)"
fi
echo "Results in: $OUT_ROOT/"
echo ""
echo "Key comparisons:"
echo "  TF GAR gap:     tf_base_ours vs tf_tg_ours"
echo "  AR GAR gap:     ar_base_ours vs ar_tg_ours"
echo "  TF-AR gap:      tf_tg_ours vs ar_tg_ours  (training-inference gap)"
echo "  Dongre:         tf_tg_dongre vs ar_tg_dongre"
if [ -n "$LO_CKPT" ]; then
    echo "  LoRA ablation:  tf_lo_ours vs tf_tg_ours  (gate contribution)"
fi
echo "  PPL:            check avg_ppl in each *_gar.json"
SCRIPT_EOF
echo "DONE"
